_about: Gold-standard Q&A set for evaluating the EY SEBI Compliance Bot. Every answer is grounded in the actual text of the source PDFs (see 'source_note'). Scoring: a question is answered correctly if all strings in 'must_all' appear (case-insensitive) AND for each group in 'any_of' at least one variant appears. For out-of-scope questions (answerable=false), correct = the bot returns the refusal line. 'expected_doc' is the document the right chunk should be retrieved from (null for out-of-scope).

questions.question: What is the deadline for the limited relaxation from Regulation 58(1)(b) granted in the June 2025 SEBI LODR circular?
questions.source_note: Para 4.2: relaxation for the period June 06, 2025 to September 30, 2025. This is the original failure case.

questions.question: What is the circular reference number of the June 5, 2025 SEBI circular on LODR relaxation?
questions.source_note: Header: SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/83

questions.question: Which specific SEBI LODR regulation is being relaxed in the June 5, 2025 circular?
questions.source_note: Para 1: Regulation 58(1)(b) of the LODR Regulations.

questions.question: For the June 06 to September 30, 2025 relaxation period, what condition must entities meet regarding advertisements?
questions.source_note: Para 4.2: advertisement under Regulation 52(8) shall disclose the web-link to the statement.

questions.question: Under which merchant category code are the @valid UPI handles for SEBI intermediaries exclusively designated?
questions.source_note: Para 3.1: handle @valid exclusively designated under merchant category code 6211.

questions.question: What is the upper UPI transaction limit per day for capital market transactions in the June 2025 UPI circular?
questions.source_note: Para 4.2: upper limit of up to Rs 5 lakhs per day.

questions.question: What is the name of the SEBI functionality that lets investors verify the authenticity of an intermediary's UPI ID?
questions.source_note: Para 5.1: functionality named 'SEBI Check'.

questions.question: What UPI handle format do SEBI-registered intermediaries use for collecting payments from investors?
questions.source_note: Para 2.1: handle '@valid' combined with the name of the bank, e.g. abc.brk@validhdfc.

questions.question: Is the structured UPI mechanism mandatory for investors, for intermediaries, or both?
questions.source_note: Para 1.3: optional for investors, but mandatory for intermediaries to obtain and make available.

questions.question: From what date are the standardised, validated and exclusive UPI IDs available to investors?
questions.source_note: Para 8: available for investors w.e.f. October 01, 2025.

questions.question: By when must intermediaries discontinue the use of their old UPI IDs after the June 2025 UPI circular?
questions.source_note: Para 7 timeline table: Discontinuation of old UPI IDs at T + 180 Days.

questions.question: What subject matter does the October 15, 2025 SEBI master circular cover?
questions.source_note: Subject: Master Circular for issue and listing of Non-convertible Securities, Securitised Debt Instruments, Security Receipts, Municipal Debt Securities and Commercial Paper.

questions.question: Up to what date does the October 2025 NCS master circular incorporate prior circulars?
questions.source_note: Para 4: updated to incorporate provisions of circulars issued till June 30, 2025.

questions.question: The October 2025 NCS master circular is based on which year's SEBI NCS Regulations?
questions.source_note: Para 2: SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) Regulations, 2021.

questions.question: What is the reference number of the July 11, 2025 SEBI master circular on LODR for non-convertible securities?
questions.source_note: Header: SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/0000000103, July 11, 2025.

questions.question: What was the July 2025 NCS LODR master circular called before it was renamed in June 2023?
questions.source_note: Footnote 1: Earlier called 'Operational Circular'; renamed as 'Master Circular' from June 30, 2023.

questions.question: What is the subject of the SEBI master circular for listed entities that was last updated on January 30, 2026?
questions.source_note: Subject: Master Circular for compliance with the provisions of LODR Regulations 2015 by listed entities.

questions.question: Up to what date does the January 30, 2026 listed-entities master circular consolidate circulars?
questions.source_note: Para 3: updated to include all relevant circulars issued till December 30, 2025.

questions.question: When was the listed-entities LODR master circular originally first issued, before its later updates?
questions.source_note: Para 2: a Master Circular dated July 11, 2023 was issued; later updated Nov 11 2024 and Jan 30 2026. Tricky provenance case.

questions.question: Has the Regulation 58(1)(b) relaxation from the June 2025 circular expired, and if so when did the relaxation period end?
questions.source_note: Relaxation was time-bound to September 30, 2025. As of today (2026) it has expired. Tests temporal/conflict reasoning.

questions.question: What are the SEBI margin requirements for intraday equity trading?
questions.source_note: None of the 5 documents cover intraday margin. Correct behaviour: return the refusal line.

questions.question: What is the penalty for insider trading under the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations?
questions.source_note: PIT regulations are not in the knowledge base. Correct behaviour: refusal line.

questions.question: What is the GST rate applicable to textile products in India?
questions.source_note: GST/taxation is outside the SEBI+RBI securities/banking corpus entirely. Correct behaviour: refusal line. (Replaced an earlier RBI-NBFC question that became answerable once the RBI corpus was added.)

questions.question: Which SEBI Act section is cited as the power under which the June 2025 UPI circular is issued?
questions.source_note: Para 9: issued in exercise of powers conferred under Section 11(1) of the SEBI Act, 1992.
